walkthrough_retry.observation: BREAK followed a dirty-row-count-only checkpoint and the prompt wait timed out. That checkpoint could also select command echo before CAT started.
walkthrough_retry.correction: Require the child foreground scope and an active console write together with multiple dirty rows before sending physical BREAK; record that checkpoint. Target image and media are unchanged.

memory.accounting: Fixed/root/kernel, each public Task, private idle, guards, alignment and unused reserved capacity included.

vram.note: Exclusive display ownership. B1 uses a 4096-byte command arena with at most 64 records and 8192 estimated bus accesses per submission. DT3 retains even and odd pointer masks in VRAM; cursor reservation grows by 256 bytes, with no new CPU aperture or bank-zero storage. DR5 reserves two compact client snapshot slots, including unused slot capacity; snapshots add no bank-zero storage. Widget repaint uses the former 5120-byte screen padding for a 640 by 16 offscreen strip; total reservation is unchanged.

limitations: Remaining focus damage is one union rectangle and repaints the area between old and new controls.
Responsiveness targets remain open; this small idle sample is not loaded timing qualification.
Flicker observer begins after model/application observation and stops at the first exact button match, excluding the pointer footprint. It is not continuous scanout or whole-gesture proof.
Strip publication is bounded drawing, not a whole-window or whole-frame atomic swap. Physical hardware is not qualified.
